summary: Circumstantial evidence case; last-seen theory requires corroboration; disclosure statement recovery under Section 27 Evidence Act requires memorandum; prosecution failed to prove recovery of corpse beyond reasonable doubt; conviction based purely on last-seen theory unsustainable; discrepancies in witness statements; appeals from Courts below dismissed for appellants 1 and 3, allowed for appellant 2; standard: must be guilty not may be guilty.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; conviction and sentence set aside; appellant Boby acquitted.
